scope: Local working tree changes; no remote or production operations

selftest_cases: Exact JWT fixture and exact comment are allowed in their respective files
Each exception content is detected outside its allowed path
A new key is detected in the JWT test path
A key appended to the allowed comment is detected
A deleted synthetic key is detected in disposable Git history
The disposable current tree is clean after key removal

limitations: GitHub-hosted CI was not run; local equivalent scanner and workflow checks only
Application Maven/frontend/container suites were not rerun for documentation and CI-only changes
Secret scanning does not detect all personal data or guarantee absence of secrets
Required branch check configuration needs separate administrator action
Historical personal and operational data remains accessible in prior Git objects and copies
